description: Default-deny capability for the main window — no fs:, no bare shell:, only core defaults, window management, the narrow dialog:allow-open grant for the project registration folder picker (T-01-02), and a shell:allow-execute grant scoped to exactly one named sidecar binary (plan 02-01, T-02-01/T-02-09) — the renderer itself has no shell capability at all; only the Rust core's own sidecar supervisor (src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs) invokes tauri-plugin-shell, and this scoped grant is what makes that invocation the ONLY process this app's shell permission can ever launch. Tauri v2's ACL/permission system gates PLUGIN commands (dialog:*, core:*, shell:*); this app's own #[tauri::command] handlers are not plugin commands and are exposed solely via main.rs's generate_handler! list, which is the actual default-deny boundary for them — no permissions/ directory defines custom ACL entries for them in this project, so listing them here would have no runtime effect (verified empirically: project_register/project_list/task_create/board_list from plan 01-03 already work without such an entry). Full app-command roster, kept here for auditability since generate_handler! is the enforcement point: project_register, project_list, project_reconcile, project_relocate, task_create, task_update, task_delete, task_set_status, task_reorder, task_set_priority, task_set_estimate, task_set_assignee, epic_create, epic_update, epic_delete, epic_set_status, epic_reorder, epic_set_priority, epic_set_estimate, epic_set_assignee, issue_create, issue_update, issue_delete, issue_reorder, board_list, board_search, actor_list, criterion_create, criterion_update, criterion_toggle, criterion_reorder, criterion_delete, criterion_list, events_activity_trail, events_since_cursor, agent_run_start, agent_run_log_window, agent_run_stop. board_search (plan 01-08, BOARD-06) is named explicitly here rather than covered by any blanket grant (T-01-02) — free-text search and every filter dimension still run as indexed, parameterised SQL inside packages/core, this command only carries the request/response across the IPC boundary. events_activity_trail/events_since_cursor (plan 01-10, BOARD-09/DATA-05) are both read-only and both cap their requested window server-side (T-01-24) before calling into packages/core. project_reconcile/project_relocate (plan 01-11, BOARD-10/D-16) never enumerate the filesystem and never write board content into a user's repository — project_reconcile re-verifies each project's already-known marker path, project_relocate writes only the identity marker at the user-chosen path after verifying it names the expected project id (T-01-29). agent_run_start/agent_run_log_window (plan 02-01, AGNT-01/D-04) validate permission_mode against a fixed four-value list and cap the log window at 100 rows server-side before ever reaching packages/core (T-02-06). agent_run_stop (plan 02-02, PROC-06/D-35) resolves the actor server-side (T-02-13), sends the sidecar's interrupt request and blocks on its ack before writing the run's terminal status, and never touches git — the worktree is left exactly as the agent left it.
